qa_method: Re-solved all 25 items from stem+choices only, then compared against proposed answers/explanations and reviewed き/けり meaning, contextual uniqueness, distractors, IDs, answer positions, exact duplicates, and high-similarity pairs.
content_review: Confirmed き as past in direct-experience/recollection contexts; けり as past in narrative, legend, reported-story, and past-habit contexts; and けり as exclamation in present discovery, realization, waka, and emotive contexts. All 25 stems had a single defensible answer from stem+choices alone.
release_rule: These IDs passed item-level content QA but are not production-approved until the future full-bank semantic near-duplicate gate is completed.
